def count_work(n, power):
    if not (1 <= n <= 65536) or n & (n-1) or power not in (0,1,2):
        raise ValueError("Use power-of-two n in [1,65536], power in [0,2]")
    if n == 1:
        return 1  # one unit per leaf
    total = count_work(n//2,power) + count_work(n//2,power)
    own = n**power
    return total  # TODO: 加上自身工作 own


tests = [(1,0,1), (2,0,3), (8,0,15), (8,1,32),
         (8,2,120), (16,1,80), (16,2,496), (1,2,1)]
passed = 0
for n,power,expected in tests:
    actual = count_work(n,power)
    ok = actual == expected
    passed += ok
    print("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", f"n={n} power={power} expected={expected} got={actual}")
print(f"{passed}/8 passed")
